featured.title: Pentagonal Lattice Geometry
featured.launchLabel: Open the Pentagonal Lattice Geometry lab
featured.pitch: A multi-sheeted covering construction in which the regular pentagon develops fractional dimension (d ≈ 2.37) and spinor-like holonomy — a discrete model where a single loop requires two passes to return to identity.

featured.title: Geometric Entropy
featured.pitch: A continuous analogue of the Erdős distinct-distance problem. Points on a manifold are arranged to extremize the Shannon entropy of their pairwise-distance distribution.

featured.title: Layered Cellular Automata
featured.pitch: Langton's ants write a colored substrate that gates where Conway's Life is allowed to live. Three feedback layers — ants → substrate → life → substrate → ants — produce highways, colonies, and fractal boundaries. For a playable take on Conway's Life and 50+ other rulesets, see the sister site The Arcade of Life ↗.

featured.title: Spacelike Knots
featured.pitch: A knot equipped with a Minkowski metric, turning crossings into causal inversions. The distance matrix becomes a causal diagram: timelike, spacelike, and null separations color-coded across the whole knot.

featured.title: Space-Color Symmetry
featured.pitch: A pixel canvas where symmetry doesn't just mirror your strokes — it rewires the diffusion graph. Heat flows along symmetry orbits, producing kaleidoscope dynamics on a quotient-like manifold.

featured.title: Irrational Lattice
featured.pitch: A new primitive: deterministic, algebraic “colored noise” for lattices. Coordinates in ℚ(√D) deform ℤᵈ and snap back via a nearest-lattice map — provably aperiodic, spectrally tunable, integer-arithmetic clean.

featured.title: Relativistic 2-Body Gravity
featured.pitch: A 2-body gravitational system with relativistic adjustments and time-delayed (retarded) interactions. Gravity propagates at finite speed c, breaking Newton's third law and producing orbital precession, frame-dragging analogues, and chaotic orbits.

featured.title: Predictive Markov Wordsearch
featured.launchLabel: Open the Predictive Markov Wordsearch lab
featured.pitch: A wordsearch generator where the filler letters aren't random — a character-level Markov model trained on reference text predicts plausible language fragments in all eight reading directions, camouflaging hidden words by matching the statistical texture of natural language.

featured.title: Fractal Learning
featured.pitch: Inverse iterated-function-system fitting: gradient-optimize a small alphabet of affine maps so the depth-N orbit of the origin matches a target point cloud under a Chamfer metric.

featured.title: No-Three-in-Line Explorer
featured.pitch: An interactive laboratory for the classic no-three-in-line problem: place ~2n points on an n×n grid so no three are collinear along any rational slope. Solve it by hand with instant collinearity feedback, or watch an entropic simulated-annealing solver with parabola warm starts, sublattice mutations, and a tabu list search for dense configurations — all powered by an incremental line index for fast O(k) move checks.

featured.title: nam — Numbers as Machines
featured.pitch: A calculator where every number is a deterministic, forkable virtual machine emitting an infinite digit stream on demand. Comparison is honestly tri-state, fork cost is annotated by tier, and unprovable digits render as 'pending (null)' rather than a comfortable lie.

featured.title: Vocal Parkour — Live Diagnostics
featured.launchLabel: Open the Vocal Parkour diagnostics panel
featured.pitch: A real-time audio-DSP diagnostics view from Vocal Parkour: a live feature visualizer (spectral radar, scrolling history, pitch readout) driven by an FFT + autocorrelation pipeline and an in-browser RBF-SVM classifier. All mic analysis runs client-side — nothing leaves your device.
